notes.title: Update: v0.1.0!
notes.content:
[h1]Playtest Update v0.1.0![/h1]

This will more-or-less be the version we launch into EA with :)

Changes:

- Entire new map algorithm that is *much* better to balance the map layouts than before

- 3 new pins available in the Hub Shop

- Fix Cultist Badge

- Fix 'Critical Strike' move

- Fix having negative xp when evolve with the "EXP Cutter" pin

- Add Basic default attack move that your Sculplings use if they are completely out of PP for all their moves

I'm so sorry for the delay of the game's official EA launch but the reworking of the map system ended up being a much bigger undertaking than anticipated and I wanted to make sure we did it before we launched. 

The new (for real this time) EA release date will be next Tuesday: 2/25! Excited to finally have it available and work on new updates!

Thanks for all the reports and feedback you guys have been providing. 

- Conor

notes.title: Sculplings Closed Beta Update: v0.0.7!
notes.content:
[h2][b]VERSION 0.0.7
[/b][/h2]

[h3]Major changes: [/h3]

- Added first member of 'The Big 5' final bosses. You challenge him after the 3rd area boss! [i](He *might* be impossible so if you manage to beat him please send a report. I haven't managed to beat him yet haha) [/i]

- You can now view your team from the move choice/level up screens.

- Equipped Badge now STAYS equipped between runs and when you load the game.

- Hub buildings highlight when mouse over

- Opponent AI improvements: Opponents will no longer use a buff if their Sculpling is already maxed on that stat.

- 10 new moves added. A few for Snek and his evolutions but I also added new "Feature" based moves that I'm really excited about. These moves are super effective against Sculplings that have [b]particular attributes[/b]. Like for example I have a new move: "My Nose is Bigger Than Yours" that does more damage against any Sculpling with a smaller nose than the user AND does double damage against a Sculpling with NO nose. I think this is a super fun way to add a little more depth to match ups than strictly just the type advantages :)

- A few minor bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed 'Morale Boost' move
[*] Fixed coins from final battle you lost at not being added to your hub bank coins
[*] A few others I'm forgetting
[/list]


Thank you all for the continued support, feedback and ideas! 

I love you all!

- Conor

notes.title: Sculplings Update v0.0.6!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Back with another update to the closed beta! Super excited about this one! Been grinding away on lots of changes:

[list]
[*] The biggest change you may see here is balancing. I have made some bosses, especially the later ones, significantly harder.
[/list]

I like when later bosses in good roguelikes have a sort of "How is this even possible" feeling when you first encounter them. I'd like to capture that feeling with the 3rd bosses in this game, requiring careful planning and a decent amount of luck to have a chance against them. Let me know what you think if you reach one of them! I think the balance of the game will be up and down for awhile, there's a lot of factors to consider, but it's a big focus for me to make sure that careful strategy and planning is necessary to beat a run completely.

Other than balance here are some other notable changes in this update:

[list]
[*] *NEW ITEM* : FLASHLIGHT - Cures a Sculpling of "SPOOKED" status
[*] Boss ability for 'The Chef'
[*] *NEW Badge* for 'Frozen Champion'
[*] Concept Art in shops are slightly less common
[*] Several new moves added
[*] Fixed 'Flash', 'Crippling Insecurity' and 'Ram' moves
[*] Can no longer "miss" buff moves
[*] Fix camera glitch when you and opponent switch monsters at same time.
[*] Art for 'Sous Chef' and 'Entitled Celeb' Opponents
[/list]

That's it for now! As always, really appreciate the feedback everyone! Still lots to do but loving the direction the game is heading :)

- Conor

notes.title: Closed Beta Update Notes v0.0.5: BADGES!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Back with another update for the Sculplings closed beta! 

The biggest change in this update is the addition of BADGES! Each boss in the game has their own unique badge that players can equip back at the Hub World! Each badge has a unique passive effect that you will start the next run with! You can only have one badge equipped at a time, so collect them all to see which bonus you prefer!

For now a lot of the effects are pretty basic, but I plan on making each effect have a more significant impact on the playstyle of the run in the future. 

In addition to badges this update includes:

[list]
[*] Polish to UI buttons
[*] Music/SFX being turned off by default
[*] Fix monsters sometimes evolving into COMPLETELY different monsters
[*] Fix Highlighting on pin icons in the corner to show their effect
[*] Camera for when someone swaps out monster
[*] 3 new pins for the HUB shop
[*] new active item - "Trap". This item damages the opponent's monster and prevents them from swapping out the monster
[/list]

[b]FYI[/b]: To fix the evolve glitch we had to do some major data changes that will mean your save will reset in this update. I'm sorry about that but from this point on your saves will be good- I guess this is why it's good to do a closed beta to fix these things haha

Thanks for always for your continued support and feedback :) I love you.

- Conor

notes.title: Playtest update- Hub World!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

This update adds a major change to the playtest demo- The Hub World!

Here players can use leftover coins from runs to:
[list]
[*] Purchase items that will appear in game runs
[*] Fund research that unlocks new Sculplings that will appear in the world
[*] Unlock concept art used for the development of the game!
[/list]

The hub world was always a major part of the game's design and I think the meta-progression it offers will add a lot of replay value! Let me know what you think! I'll be adding new things to the Hub world as development progresses :)

- Conor
